title: Indexed multi-series performance
intent: Compare four series as relative change from each series' first observation.

ai.create: Create a multi-series time chart that indexes each series to its first value, draws a 100% reference rule, and directly labels each final value.
ai.maintain: Change the index basis from the first row to a selected date while retaining one tidy input table, stable colors, inferred date and numeric channels, and percentage labels.
